notes.title: Food and Rest - The Bittersweet Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/be0e93c617b3cc223e85f5481d29e38bcc1fb7e5.png
Dear somber souls 

First of all, we would like to sincerely apologize for being a little late with the news. This past month was a bit rough and had some of our team members sick for quite some time. Our caring nature did not allow us to release the update before making sure everything was done the way it should be.
We may have had some obstacles on our way, but today we are ready and happy to announce that the NEW Bittersweet Update has just arrived! 
This is another stop on our path planned for 2022 and it brings a couple of new fun things to your Hell!
You're probably wondering what it is, right?! 
Well, well, well... 😈 

Here's what we added: 

*New building: Oven - Used to bake special treats for your lost souls... why not make them happy to exploit them more later?! 
*New building: Wheat Farm - Well needed if you want to use the Oven 
*New resource: Wheat
*Pastries - Drag them onto the sinner and shove them in their mouths! 
*New building: SPA - Just a little better than the Hibernation Chamber
*'Ongoing Event' clock
*UI Scalling 
*Balance improvements

Feeding sinners and building a SPA for them in Hell sounds too good to be true?! 
Well... we couldn't help ourselves but to add a little twist to it all. Since you can now bake different pastries for your sinners, be careful which one you choose! Each pastry has its own unique effect so we suggest for you to feed your sinners wisely... you don't want them to be too happy, right?! 
Yeah... that's what we thought 😈

Dive into the world of pain, suffering and tortures now and try the new features for yourself! 🔥

notes.title: New Update - Gothic Decoration Pack & Weeklong Deals (-30%)!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/950cb03765eca9c2101e178bf9d7d6eb21bd8656.png

Dear somber souls! 

The spooky month of October has arrived! For that occassion we have brought quite a few treats for you. We know how hard you work in your Hell. Having a dark soul and using it every day to manage the darkest place that has ever existed is a tough job, especially when your lost souls carry some of the greatest sins on their weak little shoulders. 
To get the foretaste of upcoming HELLoween we’re giving you the tools to remind your sinners how dark your soul can get! Decorate your devilish empire with brand new set of Gothic decorations! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/7a659a4cebe3b54c4a71288475e1cd7668c07d22.png

Do your sinners always seem to feel like they don’t want to take part in your show called Infernal Nightmare ?! No problem! Place Thrift Shop Guillotine to remind your sinners, that they always need to keep their heads up! Their miserable life could always get worse right?! 

Are some of your sinners extremely insubordinate? Well well well... building the Skeleton Storage Cage would be a good idea in that case! This decoration would definitely let them know that nothing gets wasted in your Hell, and that they’re stuck here forever! 😈

Being in sinner's shoes you could think, that building the Altar to CEO’s Glory could earn Lucifer’s mercy, but don’t get your hopes up! Of course we recommend trying as It won’t hurt your sinners … at least not as much as the tortures they go through all the time in your burning world of suffering!

You can find all of the new decorations in 'Decorations' -> 'Abandoned' section. 

There's also some small changes that we have implemented:

 Quality of Life - you can now deconstruct many buildings at once by dragging your cursor over 
them

 Quality of Life - you can now replace platforms without deconstructing them

To top it all off we have prepared a surprise for you, our dear sinners! Hell Architect is now 30% off ‼️ It's a limited time offer so make sure you purchase your Hell by October 18th! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/9e63f53e5f2a11d1dbd29f7ca0331cfffef5a183.png

Have fun with this brand new Gothic Decoration Pack. This is just another piece to our puzzle called The Big Update! 

Please let us know which of the decorations intimidated your sinners the most! 😈

notes.title: BIG BIG Update is COMING 😈
notes.notes:
Dear Sinners, 


Today's devlog is very informative.

1. Most of the bugs have been fixed - it was possible thanks to your feedback. Thank you very much for the Saves you sent us - it made us able to fix particular problems much faster.

If it was bugs that made Hell Architect a bad game for you, we encourage you to play again and perhaps change your review 😈😈😈

We have not rested on laurels and we are still working on the game 😎

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/8153540d4bd29e06c7060e79ab2db5dcff3f6cd4.png


2. We started working on an important UPDATE. What will be in it?

[olist]
 Random Events - you will have the opportunity to get something for free (of course it will not be that easy!), You will have to take a risk to get an unique item. In one sentence: it will be more difficult, but also more interesting! 😈
 Perk system - there will be talents (almost like in the Got Talent program) that you can buy and use 😎
 We are changing Sandbox to Hell Architect Mode - you will deal with adapting to use, uninhabited circles of hell, each map will save information about achievements on it, here you will find events and perks. Shortly: we will add a goal to make the gameplay more attractive 🔥
 We are changing the main menu 🥳
 MAC version will be available 🍏
 Mysterious new legends will come 👑
 New hellish music for your souls 🎷
 And finally: the rebalancing of costs 🤑
[/olist]

Is that all?

No!

You can also expect new decorations soon, thanks to which decorating hell has never been so cute 😈

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/0815c2a2632a1fda72d94f9d6bc328f364868e8b.png

The most important thing: when will this UPDATE be available?

We do not want to promise that in just a week. Having learned from our mistakes, we want to put these new mechanics to a very solid test. Only when we are sure that everything is actually working we will add this Update. Expect it later this year!


What about translations?
We are verifying them again, so we will update them soon - we will inform you about it.

This is not the end of surprises, but we can't reveal everything 🔥🔥🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/6e3344dd6c2e9bc71e257c7cca02aab43c3dc8cb.png


Whats change:

- General game optimization

- FIXED: Disappearing visual effect of the artifact after save&load.
- Other small changes in UI

That's not all - we will soon add more patches, new buildings and legends, and Hell Architect will keep getting better - also thanks to your feedback!


This is not the end of the news! Today is also the time to solve our competition!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901838/d83f527876e4666ba8b1eba1796c000cd1530d31.png

So the winner is...

🔥
🔥
🔥
🔥
🔥
🔥

First place 😈😈😈

Granny's Place
The torture machine is about the size of the Dentist's Chair. It's a picture of peace and tranquility with a lovable elder woman sitting on a rocking chair, knitting something or just idle. Her hands should not be visible at this moment. Her place can be decorated with floral patterned wallpaper, a small table with (very old) candy or cookies or stuff of the Biedermeier epoch. The left part of the machine is an open space where the sinner would stand. Once a sinner is assigned to this machine, Granny will leave the rocking chair, making exclamations as "My oh my! You've grown so much!" or "How thin you got!" and step towards the sinner. Her hands will become visible, a pair of frightening crustacean claws, which will mercilessly pinch and stretch out the sinner's cheeks.
Alternatively, she can grab some of the (very old) candy/cookies and stuff them into the sinner's mouth, increasing the food bar and decreasing the thirst bar.

Second place 😈😈😈

Hey sinners!

Welcome to our weekly devlog! Today shortly, but concretely!

We remind you that the Hell Architect Kickstarter starts on November 27! We will appreciate the follow  CLICK HERE TO FOLLOW US ON KICKSTARTER

It's also time to say about the release date… We know that we promised you the game by the end of this year, but despite our best efforts, we are not able to do it. 2020 just beat us 🤕 We admit that we were not prepared to work with the pandemic and the little civil war that has recently been fought in Poland 🤼
